title: Experiential Marketing Manager (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
description:
Function: Marketing
 Sub-Function: Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning)
 Designation: Manager / Deputy Manager Marketing
 Joining Location: Mumbai Andheri East
 Role Type: Individual Contributor (IC)
 Regional Responsibility: West Region, with oversight of North Region resources
 Reporting To: Senior Manager Marketing & VM
 Experience: 7+ years, preferably 89 years
 Qualification: Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing Role Overview The Manager / Deputy Manager – Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning) will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing experiential marketing, retail activation, and consumer engagement initiatives across the West region. The role will play a key part in translating brand and marketing strategies into impactful retail campaigns and on-ground consumer experiences that strengthen brand awareness, increase store engagement and support business and sales objectives. In addition to managing marketing activation initiatives for the West region, the role will also be responsible for coordinating with and overseeing the deliverables of marketing resources supporting the North region , providing direction, guidance, and mentorship to ensure consistency in execution, timelines, and brand standards. The incumbent will work closely with the Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Sales, Creative, Digital, and external agency teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of campaigns, events, activations, and other consumer-facing initiatives. Key Responsibilities 1. Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing Strategy Support the development and execution of regional experiential marketing and retail activation strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives. Translate national marketing campaigns and brand priorities into relevant regional and local market activation plans. Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement through innovative retail experiences, events, activations, and localized campaigns. Develop activation concepts that are relevant to the target consumer and aligned with the brand's positioning. Ensure all regional activations maintain consistency with brand guidelines and communication standards. Recommend new and innovative activation formats based on market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity. 2. Campaign Planning & Execution Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across retail, experiential, events, print, digital and other relevant channels. Own regional campaign calendars and ensure timely execution of planned marketing initiatives. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors for campaign planning and execution. Prepare detailed campaign briefs, execution plans, timelines, and deliverables. Monitor campaign implementation from conceptualization through execution and closure. Ensure all campaign assets, branding elements and communication materials are delivered within agreed timelines. Conduct post-campaign reviews and identify opportunities for improvement. 3. Retail Store Activation Partner with Retail Operations and Sales teams to identify opportunities for increasing customer footfall, engagement, and conversion through localized activations. Develop and execute store-level promotional activities, consumer engagement programs, and local marketing initiatives. Support new store launches, store anniversaries, key retail moments and other business-critical initiatives. Develop activation plans for high-priority stores, malls, markets, and catchment areas. Ensure activation activities are aligned with store objectives and deliver measurable business impact. Gather feedback from stores and regional teams to continuously improve activation effectiveness. 4. Experiential Events, Partnerships & Sponsorships Plan and execute experiential events, consumer engagement activities, brand experiences, and promotional events. Identify and evaluate opportunities for relevant partnerships, sponsorships, collaborations, and local events. Coordinate with athletes, influencers, event partners, malls, retailers, and other external stakeholders where applicable. Manage event agencies and other external partners to ensure quality and timely execution. Ensure event experiences are consistent with brand identity and provide meaningful consumer engagement. Track event performance and prepare post-event reports with key learnings and recommendations. 5. Market & Consumer Research Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, retail trends, and competitor marketing activities. Conduct market scans to identify relevant opportunities for regional activations. Analyze competitor campaigns, events, promotions, and consumer engagement initiatives. Provide insights to the marketing team on regional consumer preferences and market opportunities. Use market intelligence to recommend localized marketing initiatives and improve campaign effectiveness. 6. Brand Management & Compliance Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines across all regional activations and consumer touchpoints. Work closely with creative and VM teams to ensure all campaign communication and physical branding elements meet brand standards. Review marketing collateral, activation concepts, and event branding before execution. Ensure agencies, vendors and other partners understand and adhere to brand requirements. Identify and address any gaps in brand execution across the region. 7. Creative & Content Coordination Work with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop campaign and activation communication. Prepare clear creative briefs covering campaign objectives, target audience, messaging, deliverables, and timelines. Coordinate development of promotional assets, event communication, retail communication, and digital content as required. Review creative outputs and provide relevant feedback to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines. Coordinate with digital and social media teams to amplify relevant retail activation and experiential initiatives. 8. Social Media & Digital Integration Coordinate with digital/social media teams to ensure relevant experiential and retail campaigns receive appropriate digital amplification. Support the development of content around events, activations, launches, and consumer engagement initiatives. Monitor campaign-related digital engagement and consumer response. Identify opportunities to integrate offline retail experiences with digital marketing initiatives. Ensure regional activation content is aligned with the overall digital communication strategy. 9. Collaboration with Sales & Retail Operations Work closely with Sales, Retail Operations and VM teams to understand regional business priorities and translate them into marketing activation plans. Support sales teams with relevant marketing initiatives that contribute to store traffic, consumer engagement, and sales. Participate in regional business reviews and provide marketing recommendations. Ensure marketing initiatives are planned based on store requirements, business priorities, and market potential. Establish strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns. 10. West Region Ownership Take end-to-end ownership of retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives for the West region. Develop regional activation plans based on business priorities, market potential, and consumer insights. Manage the regional marketing calendar and ensure timely execution. Coordinate with stores, regional business teams, agencies, and vendors. Monitor execution quality and ensure timely resolution of regional activation-related issues. Evaluate the effectiveness of regional initiatives and share actionable insights with the senior marketing team. 11. North Region Resource Oversight & Mentoring Provide functional guidance and mentorship to marketing resources supporting the North region. Review and monitor the North team's marketing activation plans, timelines, and deliverables. Ensure consistency in campaign execution, brand standards and reporting across West and North regions. Support North resources in campaign planning, agency coordination, event execution, and problem-solving. Review key deliverables and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and effectiveness. Act as a point of coordination between North regional resources and the central Marketing & VM team wherever required. Track progress against agreed deliverables and escalate critical gaps or delays to the reporting manager. Build capability within the North resources through regular guidance, knowledge sharing and best-practice sharing. 12. Agency & Vendor Management Identify, coordinate, and manage experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production partners, and other vendors. Brief agencies clearly on campaign objectives, scope, timelines, and expected deliverables. Evaluate agency proposals and execution plans based on quality, relevance, feasibility, and cost. Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and deliverables. Ensure proper documentation and closure of marketing activities with external partners. Build strong agency/vendor relationships while maintaining commercial discipline. 13. Budget Management & Cost Optimization Support planning and management of regional marketing and activation budgets. Track campaign and activation spend against approved budgets. Ensure effective utilization of marketing spends and identify opportunities for cost optimization. Review vendor quotations and proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders. Maintain appropriate documentation for marketing spends approvals and campaign closures. Ensure activities are executed within approved financial parameters. 14. Campaign Performance & Reporting Establish relevant KPIs for retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives. Track campaign performance, consumer engagement, footfall, participation, and other relevant metrics. Prepare regular reports on campaign progress, spends, execution status and business impact. Conduct post-campaign analysis and identify key learnings. Provide actionable recommendations to improve future campaigns. Maintain a structured repository of campaign plans, reports, photographs, learnings, and performance data. 15. Cross-Functional Coordination Collaborate with Marketing, VM, Retail Operations, Sales, Digital, Creative, Finance and other internal stakeholders. Ensure effective communication of campaign requirements and timelines across functions. Coordinate multiple stakeholders simultaneously to ensure seamless campaign execution. Proactively identify execution challenges and drive timely resolution. Act as a strong bridge between the central marketing team and regional business teams. 
 Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should have: 7+ years of relevant experience , preferably 8–9 years, in Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing, Brand Activation, Events or a related field. Prior experience in retail, consumer-facing, lifestyle, footwear, fashion, FMCG, consumer durables or other retail-oriented industries will be preferred. Strong hands-on experience in experiential marketing, retail activations, events, and campaign execution . Experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously. Strong understanding of retail marketing and consumer engagement. Experience working with creative, experiential and event agencies. Ability to independently manage regional marketing initiatives from planning to execution and evaluation. Experience in mentoring or guiding junior/peer resources will be an advantage. Strong commercial understanding and ability to manage marketing budgets effectively. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment. Additional certification in Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Experiential Marketing or Event Management would be an advantage. Technical & Functional Skills Strong knowledge of Experiential Marketing and Retail Activation . Campaign planning and execution. Event management and consumer engagement. Agency and vendor management. Market and competitor analysis. Budget tracking and cost management. Campaign performance measurement and reporting. Strong understanding of retail marketing dynamics. description:
Marketing & Community Associate SkillUpExchange 
 25,000/month + performance bonus up to 35,000/quarter Full-time | In-office | Mumbai 
 Build relationships with technology professionals and help us build the distribution engine for a new technology publishing and learning company. 
 About SkillUpExchange 
 SkillUpExchange is building a new kind of technology publishing and learning company. 
 We work with experienced technology professionals and developers to create high-quality technical books, courses, audiobooks, and other learning products. 
 Our technology platform, AuthPlat , helps experts turn their knowledge into professionally produced technical content. SkillUpExchange is the consumer platform where these books and learning products are published, distributed, and connected with a broader technology learning community. 
 We are an early-stage company, which means you will not simply be executing an established marketing plan. You will help us build the plan and the processes themselves. 
 Our immediate focus is to build relationships with developers and technology professionals who can become readers, early learners, community members, advocates, course participants, and eventually even authors and instructors. 
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Marketing & Community Associate to help us build our technology community and distribution function. 
 This is a people + research + communication + execution role. A significant part of your day will involve identifying relevant technology professionals, researching their backgrounds and interests, reaching out to them through LinkedIn, starting conversations, introducing them to relevant books and learning products, and developing those relationships over time. 
 You will also work with our authors to build awareness for their books, support social media activity, develop partnerships with newsletters and technology creators, and maintain our growing community database. The role is particularly suited to someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people, is curious about technology, and likes building things from scratch. 
 You do not need to be a software developer. You do need to be comfortable learning about technology and communicating with people who work in technology. 
 What You Will Do 1. Technology Community Outreach Identify relevant developers, engineers, technology professionals, technical leaders and technology enthusiasts on LinkedIn. Build relationships with approximately 40 relevant professionals per working day . Use the founder's LinkedIn network as well as your own professional network for outreach. Research people before contacting them and understand why a particular person may be relevant to a particular book or learning product. Send personalized introductory messages and follow up appropriately. Maintain conversations rather than treating outreach as a one-time activity. Invite relevant professionals to participate as early readers, community members, or learning participants. Build long-term relationships that can be useful across multiple books and products. 
 2. Community & Relationship Management You will maintain our relationship database in Zoho Bigin . You will record useful information such as: Who we have contacted Their role and company Technology interests Which books they may be interested in Conversations and responses Early-reader participation Course or learning interests Partnership opportunities Potential future author/instructor opportunities Follow-up dates and next actions The objective is not simply to generate contacts. Every relationship we create should make future distribution easier. 
 3. Author Support & Social Media Work with our authors to help them build awareness for their books. This will include: Preparing LinkedIn content ideas for authors. Creating approximately 2 posts per week for each active author . Giving authors content options they can review and approve. Coordinating publishing schedules. Reminding authors about scheduled posts. Helping authors turn their expertise, book launches and ideas into useful social content. Preparing content for SkillUpExchange, AuthPlat and the founder's LinkedIn presence. 
 4. Partnerships Research and develop relationships with people and organizations that already have audiences interested in technology. Potential partners include: Technology newsletters Technical bloggers YouTubers Podcasts Developer communities Technology educators Community organizers Relevant online publications You will build prospect lists, initiate conversations, and track partnerships from first contact through to publication or collaboration. 
 5. Measure, Learn & Improve Because we are an early-stage company, part of your job is to help us understand what actually works . You will track the journey from: People identified contacted connected responded interested read engaged became community members purchased/participated 
 You will review the results and help us improve our approach. We care about quality of relationships, not just the number of messages sent. 
 What We Are Looking For 
 You could be a great fit if you are: Curious about technology and enjoy learning new things. Naturally comfortable talking to people. Confident communicating with professionals and senior people. Strong in written and spoken English. Good at researching people and understanding what they do. Persistent without being pushy. Organized and consistent. Comfortable working with targets and measurable goals. Interested in LinkedIn and online communities. Comfortable using AI tools and learning new software. Ambitious and interested in taking ownership. Someone who enjoys building something from scratch. 
 You do NOT need: Prior publishing experience. A traditional marketing degree. Previous Developer Relations experience. To be a software developer. An MBA. Experience at a large technology company. 
 We are more interested in your curiosity, communication skills, initiative, and ability to build relationships than your degree or previous job title. 
 Who Would Be Especially Suitable? This role could be a particularly good fit for: Recent graduates in engineering, computer science or related fields. Students or graduates who are active in technology communities. People who enjoy LinkedIn and online networking. Candidates with strong communication skills who want to work in technology. Early-career candidates interested in marketing, community building, developer relations, technology publishing or technology business. Candidates who have organized college technology events, communities or clubs. People who enjoy meeting new people and starting conversations. 
 What Success Looks Like In your first few months, success will mean building a real and growing network of relevant technology professionals . You will be expected to contribute to: Growth of our developer and technology professional network. Early-reader participation for our books. Genuine Amazon reviews and reader feedback. LinkedIn visibility and author-generated content. Newsletter, creator and community partnerships. Growth of our CRM/community database. Better understanding of which outreach and distribution channels work. 
 The most important thing is that you help us move from: We have published a book. to “We know how to consistently find the right people to read it.”

E-Commerce & Performance Marketing Manager
 Company: Nexzu Mobility Limited
 Location: Mumbai (or Pune Chakan facility)
 Reports to: Founder
 Type: Full-time
 Experience: 47 years

 About us 
Nexzu Mobility builds electric cycles for India the Stormrider fat-tyre commuter, the Stormboy for kids and teens, and the Roadlark Cargo for last-mile delivery. We are part of a vertically integrated group: our battery packs are manufactured in-house at our Chakan facility, and our cycles run in commercial rental fleets across Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai.
We sell on Amazon, Flipkart, Firstcry and our own website, alongside a growing dealer network. We are scaling from 19 orders a month to 100, and we are hiring the person who will own that number.
 The role 
You will own every rupee of online revenue and every rupee of online ad spend. That means a growing monthly media budget across Amazon Ads, Flipkart PLA, Meta and Google, and an ambitious order target on a 40,000+ product.
This is a hands-on role, not a coordination role. You will be in Seller Central and Ads Manager daily. You will brief and hold an external creative agency to account. You will be measured on cost per order and net revenue not on impressions, reach or leads.
If you want a job where you forward agency reports to leadership, this is not it. If you want to own a P&L line and have the authority to move it, read on.
 What you will own 
 Marketplace performance 
• Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub end to end listings, A+ content, pricing, buy box, inventory health, returns and account metrics
• Amazon Sponsored Products and Sponsored Brands campaigns; Flipkart PLA
• Firstcry channel for the Stormboy range
• Keyword research, listing optimisation and review management
 
 Paid media 
• Meta and Google campaigns on conversion objectives planning, execution and daily optimisation
• Managing our external creative agency: briefs, deadlines, quality control, performance accountability
• Budget pacing. We have overspent two months running. That stops with you.
 Website 
• Conversion rate on nexzu.in, including checkout health. We recently lost 1.8 lakh in cancelled orders to a checkout problem that is the kind of thing you find before we do.
• Product pages, EMI messaging, analytics and pixel integrity
 Data and reporting 
• One monthly reconciliation: spend, orders, cost per order, cancellations, returns, net revenue, blended CAC
• Weekly performance review with the founder
• Every number must tie out. We have had reports where the same campaign appeared twice and the ROAS did not reconcile with the stated spend. You will build reporting we can trust.
 Lead management 
• Meta lead campaigns generate volume we currently do not convert. You will build the follow-up process and own lead-to-order conversion.
 What we are looking for 
 Must have 
• 47 years in e-commerce or performance marketing, with at least 2 years hands-on in Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub
• Demonstrable P&L or CAC ownership you can talk through a channel you scaled and what it cost
• Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads at a working level, on conversion objectives
• Strong spreadsheet skills. You should be able to build a CAC model without being asked twice.
• Comfort holding an agency to account
 
 
 Strongly preferred 
• Experience with considered-purchase products above 20,000 where the funnel is long and EMI matters
• D2C, consumer durables, mobility, or EV category background
• GA4, Meta Pixel and Conversions API setup experience
• Working Hindi and Marathi alongside English
 Who fits 
• You are sceptical of your own numbers before anyone else is
• You would rather report a real CAC of 3,000 than a flattering ROAS you cannot defend
• You are comfortable being the only person in the room who owns this function
• You want to build the system, not inherit one
 Why this is worth your time 
• You will own a channel outright, reporting directly to the founder no layers, no committee
• Real budget authority from day one, scaling through the year
• A category with genuine tailwind, and a group that controls its own battery supply
• Performance-linked incentive tied to orders and CAC, not to activity
 How to apply 
Send your CV to hrd@nexzu.co.uk with a short note answering one question:
 You are given 1,00,000 a month to sell a 42,000 electric cycle. How would you deploy it, how many orders would you expect, and what do you measure in week one? 
Half a page is plenty. We care about how you think, not how you write.
